products.title: Capterra products
products.description: Products to scrape. Each entry can be a Capterra URL (e.g. https://www.capterra.com/p/164283/Zendesk/ or .../reviews/), an ID/slug pair (e.g. 164283/Zendesk), or a plain product name (e.g. zendesk), which is resolved with Capterra search.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Stop after this many reviews for each product. 0 means no limit. Capterra only exposes the first 100 review pages (2,500 reviews) per product.

maxPagesPerProduct.title: Max pages per product
maxPagesPerProduct.description: Stop after this many review pages (25 reviews each) for each product. 0 means no limit.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of browser pages open at the same time.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: How many times a failed or blocked page is retried, each time with a fresh proxy session.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Capterra sits behind Cloudflare. Apify Proxy is strongly recommended; residential proxies give the best success rate.
